title: First Steps
scope: Control/retry slice, not the proposed full three-zone course
note: All coordinates rescaled x2 on 2026-09-13 for the taller character sprite.
crates_note: Breakable targets, [x, ground_y]. Area2D only, never solid, so they cannot block or alter the platforming route. Delete this array to remove them; the attacks work without any targets present.
bottles_note: Milk, [x, ground_y, heal]. Player spawns on 25 of 100 health; this one is placed between the first crate and the spikes, so it is found after the player has learnt to punch and before the first real hazard.
